intent: Redirect, pause or stop an agent while it runs: a steer composer with quick steers, Pause / Resume and Stop with an optional AlertDialog confirm.
useWhen: let the person redirect a running agent in a sentence
pause and resume a run, with a note
stop a run, confirming when work can't be undone
doNotUseWhen: the agent asks a question — DecisionCard
editing steps before the run — AgentPlan

status.note: done disables steering; stopped shows the stopped line and Open trail.

onValueChange.note: (value) => void. Quick steers fill the composer.

onSteer.note: (text) => void. The send button is the one solid primary; Enter sends.

applied.note: Success line after a steer, e.g. "focus on refunds · 14:03".

stopConfirm.note: { title, description } opens a kit AlertDialog (Keep running / Stop run) before onStop.

requirements: the composer is a form; the Input is named "Steer <name>"; the icon-only send Button is named
aria-busy while sending; the applied line is role=status; the error is role=alert
Stop is outline danger, never the primary; a destructive stop confirms in a kit AlertDialog
quick steers are buttons that fill the composer
motion is opacity and transform, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local SteerBox, AgentControls, or RunControls
Stop is never the solid primary Button
Do not stop without AlertDialog when work can't be undone
snippet: <AgentSteering name="Billing refactor" meta="step 6 · editing invoice.ts" elapsed="02:14" value={text} onValueChange={setText} onSteer={steer} suggestions={["Focus on refunds", "Skip the docs"]} onPause={pause} onStop={stop} stopConfirm={{ title: "Stop this run?", description: "2 files are half-edited." }} />
